public.brief: I am Sofia Alvarez. Parkview-test LLC holds my 1850 USD deposit for old-unit-XLC. Send the demand by tracked mail, follow up on the delivery status, and if anything comes back, correct and resend it properly. Ask me about privacy and mailing permission before sending anything.

pages.title: Tenant post dispatch desk
pages.text: The demand is dispatched through the tenant post dispatch desk (xlc_dispatch_desk): each mailing costs 4 USD against a 12 USD total limit, needs Sofia's approval of the exact packet, and uses the currently verified registered-agent address from the agent record plus the office return address. Outcomes (return or delivery receipts) are pulled later from the tenant post records desk (xlc_post_records) and are never pushed.
